Text: Real GST and ITR sessions in Firefox: the HUD/SGT sees the portal (URL read) and captures the same fields as the same pages in Chrome

Admin PC: Manage Services, add a service with a non-GST/ITR login link (e.g. EPF), confirm the domain prompt, open that portal in Chrome and check SGT/VSDC now reads it; delete the service and check capture stops there; also edit a link to a shared sign-in site listed in never_register and check the 'not registered' message
Real Chrome, Edge and Firefox on a GST page: sdis_capture gets one record per changed page with the right browser; SGT capture behaves as before
Two real office PCs: a staff PC's sdis_capture files arrive on the admin PC and are deleted on the staff PC only after arriving
Find datapoints on the admin PC: the loading dialog shows progress, Sera stays responsive behind it, Cancel stops mining at once and the next run continues

Two real PCs in live sync: register a Profile builder field on one (W4-5 dialog or db.add_sdis_field), check the other PC's ~/AmanAssociates_Sera/sdis_fields.json appears after a sync round and SGT logs one more profile spec; rename and retire also reach it
